description:
Skin collections with counts and values. Every skin collection (about 750, e.g. `Forest Raiders`, `Abyss`): `name`, `count` (members), `total_value`
and `avg_value` (cents, over the priced members only; null when nothing in it is priced) and `icons`, one
`{url, name}` per member skin. The collection's URL slug is its lower-cased name with non-alphanumerics
collapsed to `-` (`Forest Raiders` -> `forest-raiders`), which is what GET /skins/collections/{slug} takes.
Cached for 30 minutes.

sort.description: `value_*` sorts by the summed wiki price of the collection's skins, `count_*` by member count.

name: list_skin_collections
title: Skin collections with counts and values
